title: .gitignore silently excluded the three registered build artifacts from the pushed record
rule: .gitignore line 11 matches any directory named build, so docs/browser-acceptance/runs/<run>/artifacts/build/ was ignored
consequence: A plain git add skipped them without any warning, so the pushed record was incomplete: a fresh clone could not satisfy the validator even though the working tree did. Local validation passed only because the files were still present on disk.
detection: Reported by the user with the Linux resume note; confirmed with git check-ignore -v and git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard (exactly 3 ignored files, 0 other untracked files).
fix: Force-added exactly those three paths with byte-identical content; the staging area contained exactly those three paths; the index tree d99260980a2085df7cbb596666f71e7ccf96d863 was exported with git archive and validated from the export with the healthy tools clone.
lesson: A clean git status does not prove that a record was fully committed: ignored paths are invisible to it. Any future round should validate a fresh export of the index tree, not the working tree.
